about.pl: Wezwanie zamykające modlitwy Leona XIII, dołączone do nich w 1904 r. za Piusa X. Powtarza się je trzy razy. To wydanie drukuje je raz.
about.en: The invocation that closes the prayers of Leo XIII, added to them in 1904 under Pius X. It is said three times. This edition prints it once.

function.en: A neuter noun has one form for nominative and vocative. This edition tags the address as nominative, as it does in Agnus Dei.

function.pl: Stopień najwyższy od „sacrátus”. Zgadza się z „Cor” (w001).
function.en: The superlative of “sacrátus”. It agrees with “Cor” (w001).

function.pl: Tryb rozkazujący czasownika deponentnego: forma bierna, znaczenie czynne.
function.en: The imperative of a deponent verb: passive in form, active in meaning.

function.pl: Celownik zależny od „miserére”. W łacinie klasycznej czasownik ten zwykle łączy się z dopełniaczem.
function.en: Dative dependent on “miserére”. In Classical Latin this verb usually takes the genitive.

editorial.notes: The invocation that closes the prayers of Leo XIII, added to them by Pius X in 1904. Five words, and it is said three times — which this edition states in the reader's introduction rather than printing three identical pairs. Witness do prints all three; its transcription takes the first pair only and says so. COR at w001 is nominative in the function of address, as AGNUS is in the Agnus Dei: the form is a neuter one that would not show the difference anyway, and this edition marks the case the analyzers head. IESU at w002 is genitive — one of the four cases this Greek-Latin name spells alike, and the only one the sense allows here.
